style.preamble: Weather Bulletin. For the following counties, in (State), (County), (County), and (County) (and in (State), (County), (County), and (County)); for one county it is ((County), (State)). For FFWs the first words are "Flash Flood Warning" instead of "Weather Bulletin".
style.reportScript: Please Report Severe Weather by calling 4 1 2, 2 6 2, 1 9 8 8, posting to the National Weather Service Pittsburgh Facebook Page, or using twitter at N W S Pittsburgh.
